## Facet category

Which facet does this addition belong to? (e.g., `method_family`, `condition`, `dataset`, `metric`, `task`, `modality`, or a new domain profile)

## New profile or additions to existing profile

- **Profile**: (e.g. `core` or `computer_vision/optical_flow` or `nlp/summarization`)
- **Key**: (e.g. `method.mamba`)
- **Aliases**: (e.g. `["mamba", "selective state space", "s6"]`)

## Justification / Example papers

List 1-2 representative papers that use these terms to avoid ambiguous keyword matching.
